procedure_summary: The benzoate salt from the preceding step is etherified at the benzylic position, either by an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance or by a preformed alkali metal alkoxide, in a polar aprotic solvent in the cold. The solvent is removed, the residue is diluted with water and acidified with hydrochloric acid, and the alkoxymethyl benzoic acid is filtered off and dried.
notes: Step (2) of the claimed process, recited by claim 1 (line 47) and restated with ratios, time, temperature and workup by claim 10 (line 112); procedure_text carries both verbatim, in that order, for the same reason as step 1. One record, not two, although the claim offers two reagent systems for the same transformation: the benzoate salt with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or the benzoate salt with a preformed alkali metal alkoxide. Both displace the benzylic bromide and both give the same product, so they are alternatives within one step, and every alternative reagent is listed in compounds[]. reaction_class is nucleophilic_substitution and the named reaction is the Williamson ether synthesis. ACIDIFICATION, an internal tension recorded and not resolved: claim 1 has step (2) give the free benzoic acid directly, while claim 8 states that it is the acidification with hydrochloric acid to pH 2 to 3 after the reaction that gives the acid, and claim 10 lists acidification among the post-reaction operations. The immediate product of the substitution is the carboxylate, not the acid, so the two recitations do not agree about what step (2) ends with. The acidification is recorded as a workup operation, with hydrochloric acid in compounds[] with role acid, and the product is the acid the claim names. No listed validation flag covers a disagreement of this kind between a claim and its dependent, so it is recorded here rather than flagged. THE ALKOXIDE PREPARATION is a third transformation this patent performs, and it is not given its own record here. Claim 7 says only that the alkali metal alkoxide is obtained by reacting an alcohol with sodium or potassium metal: no charge, no solvent, no temperature, no isolation, and claim 10, the fully specified process claim, recites the process as two steps. In the worked examples the alkoxide is made, isolated and sealed and does deserve its own record; in the claims it is recited only as the origin of a reagent. A0 also counted two steps for this section. The two metals are therefore carried in compounds[] with role alkoxide_precursor so the information stays recoverable, and they are not reagents of the substitution itself. Order of addition, from claim 7: with an alcohol and a base, the base and the alcohol go into the solvent first and the benzoate salt after; with the alkali metal alkoxide, the alkoxide goes into the solvent first and the benzoate salt after. Claim 9 adds that the salt is charged in batches over a total addition time of 1 to 3 h. Both are in that compound's addition_profile, where the addition time belongs, and not in time_h. Numbers the schema cannot hold: time_h is null because the reaction time is given only as a range; ph_value and workup.ph_target are null because the pH is given as a range, so ph_target_stage names the stage and the range is kept in workup.steps; equivalents are null throughout because every stoichiometry in claims 5 to 8 is a range. The temperature is a range and is recorded in full. Solvent removal is a workup operation, so it sets concentration_method and not a reaction pressure. The product name stays generic: alkoxymethyl leaves the alkyl group unspecified, and claim 5 allows two alcohols, so the claims cover two products without naming either. The Chinese name of the benzoate salt straddles the page break between lines 85 and 90, and the EN convenience line at line 86 is truncated mid-word there; the Chinese is authoritative and complete, so this is a rendering artifact and not a translation conflict. (2)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐在碱性物质存在下与醇反应或者将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐反应，得到所述2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸。
作为本发明优选的技术方案，步骤(2)中所述醇为2,2,2-三氟乙醇或2-四氢呋喃甲醇。
优选地，步骤(2)中2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与与醇的摩尔比为1:(1.05～1.35)，例如可以是1:1.05、1:1.15、1:1.25或1:1.35。
作为本发明优选的技术方案，步骤(2)中所述碱性物质为氢氧化钠、氢氧化钾、叔丁醇钠、叔丁醇钾、氢化钠、氢化钾中的任意一种。
优选地，所述氢氧化钠使用时先制成氢氧化钠水溶液，氢氧化钠的质量浓度为30～96％，例如可以是30％、40％、50％、60％、70％、85％或96％。
优选地，所述氢氧化钾使用时先制成氢氧化钠水溶液，氢氧化钾的质量浓度为30～96％，例如可以是30％、40％、50％、60％、70％、85％或96％。
优选地，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱性物质的摩尔比为1:(1.2～1.5)，例如可以是1:1.2、1:1.3、1:1.4或1:1.5。
作为本发明优选的技术方案，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐的摩尔比为1:(1.2～1.5)，例如可以是1:1.2、1:1.3、1:1.4或1:1.5。
优选地，步骤(2)中所述碱金属醇盐为醇和碱金属反应得到。
优选地，所述碱金属为金属钠或金属钾。
在本发明中，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐在碱性物质存在下与醇反应时，加料顺序为先将碱性物质与醇加入反应溶剂中，而后加入所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐。
在本发明中，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐反应时的加料顺序为先将碱金属醇盐放入溶剂中，再加入所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐。
本发明中，步骤(2)中加料顺序是不可改变的，若将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐先放入溶剂中，滴加碱性物质与醇的混合液或者滴加醇钠或醇钾进行反应，则苄醇杂质以及双接杂质会大幅增加。
作为本发明优选的技术方案，步骤(2)中使用的溶剂为乙腈、DMF、DMSO或THF中的任意一种或至少两种的组合。
优选地，步骤(2)中相对于1mol的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐，所述溶剂的用量为700～3500mL，例如可以是700mL、1000mL、1500mL、2000mL、2500mL、3000mL或3500mL。
作为本发明优选的技术方案，步骤(2)中所述反应的温度为-5～15℃，例如可以是-5℃、0℃、5℃、10℃或15℃。
优选地，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐分批加入步骤(2)的反应体系中，所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐的总加料时间为1～3h，例如可以是1h、1.5h、2h、2.5h或3h；
优选地，步骤(2)中所述反应时间为3～6h，例如可以是3h、4h、5h或6h。
优选地，步骤(2)中所述反应完成后经过酸化得到所述2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸。
优选地，所述酸化使用的酸为盐酸。
优选地，所述酸化后反应体系的pH值为2～3，例如可以是2、2.1、2.3、2.4、2.5、2.7或3。
(2)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐在碱性物质存在下与醇反应，所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与醇的摩尔比为1:(1.05～1.35)，与碱性物质的摩尔比为1:(1.2～1.5)，或者将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐反应，所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐的摩尔比为1:(1.2～1.5)，反应时间3～6h，反应温度为-5～15℃，经脱溶、水稀释、酸化、过滤和烘干后得到所述2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸。
procedure_summary: The benzoate salt is reacted either with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance or with a preformed alkali metal alkoxide, which displaces the benzylic bromide and forms the ether. The base and the alcohol, or the alkoxide, go into the solvent first and the salt is added afterwards in batches, and acidification, dilution, filtration and drying then give the alkoxymethyl benzoic acid.
notes: PROSE step (2) of the technical scheme in 发明内容, recited at [0019] and again, with its parameters gathered together, at [0057]. The conventions listed in the notes of step (1) apply here too. TWO ROUTES IN ONE STEP, not a one-pot sequence: [0019] offers the benzoate salt either with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or with an alkali metal alkoxide. These are alternatives for the same transformation, not two transformations in series, so is_one_pot stays false and one_pot_steps is empty. compounds[] therefore holds the components of both routes; the two alcohols of [0035] are alternatives to each other as well, [0022] pairing R with 2,2,2-trifluoroethyl or 2-tetrahydrofurylmethyl. ALKALI METAL ALKOXIDE: 碱金属醇盐 is a generic class and, matching A1 and the reference run, is not emitted as a compound record, so no a1_missing_compound arises from it; its claimed ratio is carried in molar_ratio_text. [0042] and [0043] add that the alkoxide is obtained by reacting an alcohol with an alkali metal, sodium metal or potassium metal. That is a third transformation of the process, and in the Examples that actually perform it, where it has its own charge and its own isolated solid, it is annotated as its own step. Here it is not: this section states only where the alkoxide comes from, with no charge, no solvent, no temperature, no time and no isolation, and A0 counted two steps for this section. The judgement is recorded here rather than resolved silently, and sodium metal and potassium metal are consequently not in compounds[] for this step, because they are not charged into it. ADDITION ORDER, which the section makes load bearing: [0044] puts the basic substance and the alcohol into the solvent first and the benzoate salt after; [0045] puts the alkoxide in first and the benzoate salt after; [0050] adds the salt in batches over a total of 1～3h; and [0046] states the order cannot be changed, because putting the salt in first and adding the base and alcohol mixture, or the sodium or potassium alkoxide, dropwise makes the 苄醇 impurity and the 双接杂质 double-attachment impurity increase greatly. Those two impurities belong to the reversed order the section forbids, not to the disclosed procedure, so they are not recorded in compounds[]. CLASSIFICATION: the benzylic bromide is displaced by an alkoxide, so reaction_class is nucleophilic_substitution with high confidence and named_reaction is Williamson ether synthesis. [0023] calls it a 缩合反应, a condensation, which is the patent's own looser wording. TIME: [0051] gives 3～6h, a range no schema field holds, so time_h is null and the range is recorded here. The temperature range -5～15℃ of [0049] fits the temperature object; no cooling method is named, so cooling_method is null. ACIDIFICATION IS WORKUP, not a reagent of the substitution: [0052] acidifies after the reaction is complete, [0053] names hydrochloric acid and [0054] gives pH 2～3. ph_value and workup.ph_target both hold a single number and the text gives a range, so both are null and the range is carried in ph_target_stage and in the workup narrative.
